title: QEnvS: physically validated quantum control environments for reinforcement learning and optimal control
description: Model zoo of open-quantum-system control problems, including transmon gate synthesis, cross-resonance control, quantum batteries with collective and local dissipation, and qubit and three-level state transfer. It provides model-specific physics checks, a functional JAX environment API (jit/vmap/grad), parameter randomisation, finite-shot observations, robust evaluation, a Gymnasium adapter and a JSON command-line interface. Custom Hamiltonian models support explicit battery subsystems and endpoint trajectory diagnostics. Built on dynamiqs.
